reason_note: The project owner explicitly chooses to leave TikTok blocked for now and authorizes the next Queue to perform a one-time round-robin live acquisition campaign across previously studied sources. Each source receives a bounded X-record slice before execution advances to the next source; terminally exhausted or blocked sources become to_be_skipped and are omitted on later rounds. The campaign stops at 50,000 accepted unique records or when no eligible active source remains, then performs zero-provider fixture replay for every source and exports CSV, JSONL and XLSX by domain in one ZIP with manifest and failure report.

authorized_scope.source_universe: Previously studied KU2D sources with durable registry, technique, readiness or fixture evidence; registry-only seeds without a reviewed executable technique are preflight-skipped without provider access.

phase_package_scope_policy.enforcement: Every P59 phase must declare all seven fields and may narrow but never widen authority.

provenance.source_context: Project owner selected TikTok deferral and requested a fair cyclic multi-source campaign, terminal skip behavior, 50,000-record global ceiling, final fixture replay and domain-separated download bundle.
